dead_code.note: Reachability over the resolved graph: high = unreachable under every modelled assumption (incl. dead clusters); medium = alive only if dynamic dispatch occurs. Verify before deleting - reflection and string registries are not modelled.

blocking_call_scan.note: Cannot distinguish async def from sync context. Not mounted by default for this reason.

domain_boundary_audit.note: Requires a project-supplied layer map. Not mounted until one exists.

symbol_graph.note: Resolved edges, not name matches. Use refs before deleting or renaming anything - inbound is the real caller list. The honesty ledger bounds what 'no references' proves.
